evidence.summary: Learning objective and scope: Defines attempt_move(index) as the single path for every input method, separating move validation from move consequences, and establishes that an invalid move must not switch the player.

A move is valid only if the game is not over and the cell is empty; otherwise it is ignored. -- confirmed against the canonical app -- attempt_move on an occupied cell leaves board unchanged, and attempt_move after game_over leaves board[5] == ''.
An invalid move must not switch the current player. -- confirmed -- after X plays cell 0 (current_player becomes 'O'), a second attempt_move(0) leaves current_player == 'O'.

After a valid move the order is: commit to the model, check for a winner, then check for a draw, and only then switch the player. -- confirmed -- tic_tac_toe.py implements exactly this order, and the behavioural consequence was verified: a winning ninth move reports a win, not a draw.
The if/else form and the conditional-expression form of switching the player are equivalent. -- confirmed -- both forms executed over both input values and produce identical results.
